items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: goes back to George Washington's time, that would be 1700

ctx.x: and it poured, and this great outdoor auditorium, and if you know anything about Eddie Condon, instead of playing the guitar, he took it upon himself to conduct the six pieces, and because of the rain which didn't cover the back, or the front of the show, where he announced, he had an umbrella over his head -- and it made quite a picture.

Since then, I've done many of the Newport Festivals, especially when they moved down to New York, and they call them now the New York Newport Festivals. I've done them with the World's Greatest Jazz Band, and I've done them especially with Eddie Condon. And the last couple of years, they've had a subsidiary that is part of the Newport Festival down in New Jersey. Sponsored by the New Jersey Jazz Society in connection with -- or I should say the New Jersey Jazz Society working hand in hand with George Wein. And…

There will be much more later of what the New Jersey Jazz Society is doing for jazz, and the promotion and preservation of it, and doing very well along the concert lines every year, and we musicians are greatly indebted to them, and we'll get to that another time. But I must
